item.title: Is AI really a job killer? Some employers say they’re actually hiring more
item.description: A new report from ZipRecruiter suggests that some companies are adding jobs due to AI or plan to in the near future. The fear that AI is killing jobs has been fueled by ongoing layoffs across corporate America, most recently at companies like Visa. Just this week, the payments giant revealed plans to shed 7% of its headcount, a move that will impact 2,600 employees. While Bloomberg reported that AI wasn’t the only factor driving the layoffs, CEO Ryan McInerney clearly cited it in his memo, noting AI would “shape the way work gets done at Visa.” Some of its peers, like PayPal, have also made b...
